title: Prove the herding brief asks for the principles answer and the job carries it
action: Test only, no product code. Add tests asserting observable output: (a) a worker-cell brief rendered for a herding dispatch with a non-empty principles value asks for principles_used in the result file; (b) the native render does not carry that herding sentence. Run them; a red is a finding returned as blocked with the output. Bee commands you may run: none beyond the verify. Run no dispatch verb, not even its help.
